rfis.subject: Deck Concrete Embed Clash with Surgical Light Boom Anchor Pattern
rfis.question: Structural drawing S-102 calls for 5/8 inch threaded rods directly into deck inserts, but post-tension cable sleeve PT-4 runs directly through the centroid of OR-1 light boom mount. Please advise alternative spreader frame.
rfis.suggestedSolution: Install 4-inch structural tube steel bridge spanning between joists J-4 and J-5.
rfis.officialResponse: Approved to install structural bridge framing per sketch SK-S-012 attached. Contractor to submit PCO for steel addition.
